4372b717ece66dec4580740d1e43b840fe943e36.summary: Flashpoint reports that the FIN7 cybercrime gang kept attacking businesses and payment card data after arrests began in January 2018. Flashpoint links a new Astra attack panel, SQLRat and DNSbot malware to FIN7 in campaigns active May to July 2018. Attacks start with industry-specific phishing emails carrying lure documents. The report cites DoJ figures of more than 15 million stolen payment card records and 6,500 point-of-sale terminals infiltrated.
